label: Relational receipt after ST I q.45 a.3: does a real relation to the giver carry the sustaining crux?
summary: The next test named by attempt 50e08b09. Note docs/notes/sustaining-vs-existential-inertia.md section 6; module TruthCore.Causality.RelationalReceipt, spec specs/relational-receipt.toml. Texts read in pinned witnesses: ST I q.45 a.3 (passage fb7bd7bb, newly pinned in the admitted SCTA Leonine transcription; objections, sed contra, corpus, ad 1-3) and ST I q.13 a.7 (passage 12d8ecc5, newly pinned in the same SCTA file as a.5 and a.8); q.104 a.1 re-read. q.45 a.3 co.: creation in the creature is only a relation to the Creator as principle of its esse, by analogy with the passion that comes with motion; ad 1: real in the creature, of reason in God; ad 3: the creature is the subject of the relation and prior to it in being, and a creature need not be said to be created as long as it exists, because creation imports the relation 'cum quadam novitate seu incoeptione'. q.13 a.7 co.: relations between a being and a non-being are of reason only; real relations consequent on action and passion include both 'motivum et mobile' and 'pater et filius'; ad 6: simultaneity by nature is settled by signification. No claim is recorded (the Lean relation is time-indexed; the texts are not). Typed a primitive origin relation (definition 7b28be97) and a third sense of present receipt, RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_3 relationalReceipt (definition 2a7f7142, appended to disambiguation 71d3bdb7): standing receipt plus a real relation borne at the moment to something as to the principle of being. Open premises: foundation ef7ef827 (q.45 a.3 ad 3), accompaniment 9fecbef4, coexistence of the term 264b6b5e (warrant independent of 40a97664: q.13 a.7 co.), giving by the term 6da7d94a. Results: accompaniment + giving by the term give 40a97664 (a0b5227d, transcription); on RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_3 the present-tense reading is accompaniment (42590821); given accompaniment, relational correlativity is equivalent to 40a97664 (1637b89a); with the relation left open, a founded accompanying relation with a giving term exists iff 40a97664 (b5e9b376); foundation + accompaniment + coexistence of the term + received onset given do not entail 40a97664 (b9920133). Controls 584bac58: a creator present throughout who gives being at onset only, with the creature's relation persisting, satisfies foundation, accompaniment, coexistence of the term and received onset, and falsifies giving by the term and 40a97664; the relation at onset only (creation with novelty) satisfies giving by the term and falsifies accompaniment; a term absent after onset falsifies coexistence of the term; sustaining satisfies all. truth countermodel does not support History-typed parameters, so controls are hand-built and Lean-checked. Finding: correlativity gains one independently warranted component, coexistence of the term, but it does not reach giving; the remaining step, giving by the term, says the creature's relation is of the present-action type (mover and moved) rather than the completed-action type (father and son), and is 40a97664 restated (1637b89a, b5e9b376). Strongest rival mechanism (Substantive Objection Standard): the creature's relation is a real relation consequent on a completed action, persisting while its eternally existing term exists, as filiation persists while the father lives; justification: q.13 a.7 co. classes 'pater et filius' among real relations consequent on action and passion, q.45 a.3 ad 3 makes creation under that name onset-indexed, and filiation's persistence after begetting is ordinary use (not stated in the passage). The dead-father variant is excluded by coexistence of the term (q.13 a.7: relations to a non-being are of reason). The sustaining reply (a father causes becoming only, God causes being, q.104 a.1) bears on the relation's type only through the illumination profile carried to esse, which presupposes 40a97664. Classification: the crux restated; no item added to inertia's price; the section 4 judgment stands. The vertical approach of re-reading receipt is exhausted: passion (present-tense reading is the crux), standing composition (correlativity is the crux), relation (giving by the term is the crux, coexistence too weak). Side finding: accompaniment and coexistence give only some term present at each moment of presence, not the single tenseless cause co-present in every history that the antecedent of co-presence bridge ffcb81fb needs; no premise moves.
blocker: No re-reading of receipt yields a further discriminating test. What would still discriminate is horizontal: (1) an argument from another family (a PSR variant for persistence, the contingency family's explanation of existing now) that persistence at t needs an explanation at t, without the illumination analogy or the extended actualization principle; (2) a participation-family account of received esse (q.104 a.1 'being by participation'; De ente c.4) on which participated act is not a completed terminus, with warrant not assuming 40a97664; (3) a matching-scope comparison of inertia's positive commitments (persistence needs no cause; conservation laws) with the sustaining account on the same persistence data. Revision condition: a typed, independently warranted premise excluding completed-action relations for relations to a cause of esse.
